palette: Royal cobalt or deep crimson scales, black recesses, and luminous gold edge accents.
valueRange: Rich saturated darks with brilliant armored ridges.
surfaceAndWear: Large ancient scales, layered enamel-like sheen, scarred high ridges, nearly impenetrable overlaps.
constructionVocabulary: Regal scale fields, pronounced crests, sweeping draconic panels, gold-bound joints, powerful silhouette.
supernaturalBehavior: A restrained elemental gleam travels through a few scale edges; no breath effect.
neutralSecondaryMaterials: Black leather, dark steel, gold fittings, and charcoal lining.
neighborDifference: Larger, more regal, and more magically potent than Drakescale; less colossal and primeval than Ancient Dragon Scale.
